text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… This year's Takarazuka Kinen… is gonna be held… in Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's right after the spring Tenno… so the track'll be all beat up! …And that's gonna make the race real demanding!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Ryan. So even on your days off you come and train at the gym, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright! Yep, well, the big day's coming up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hard work doesn't always get you results. But if you want to win, you do have to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's why I want you and Dober to come watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've prepped a present for you both. And I can give it to you at the Takarazuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Of course. The two of us will absolutely be there to see you shine. And I imagine we'll learn something from it as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But if I end up losing after getting your hopes up… Sorry in advance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Oh, Ryan. Your jests are terribly funny, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen arrives.

text_block_list.name: Spectator in Suit
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, but what time does Ines Fujin's race begin today?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's the main race for today, so it won't start until after 3:30! Are you one of Fu's fans, then?

text_block_list.name: Spectator in Suit
text_block_list.text: Well… Yes, I am. I'd very much like to cheer her on at a real racecourse, you see.

text_block_list.name: Spectator in Suit
text_block_list.text: …In truth, she's my subordinate. She works part-time in our delivery department.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Really?! She works at my place, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What?! No way! My boss at the ramen shop and my manager at my part-time job are getting buddy-buddy?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So they hit it off here at the venue and now they're supporting me from the stands… How does that even happen?!
choice_data_list: It's nice of them to come all the way out to Kyoto.
It's nice of them to come all the way out to Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm just surprised that they'd both make the trip just to cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But if they're here because they're dreaming through me too, then…)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I can't let them down.
choice_data_list: Let everyone's support be your strength!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, you're right! I'm gonna do just that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Ryan and McQueen are both racing today.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But so am I…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Here they come!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: McQueeeeen! Ryaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I don't even need a good look at Ryan to tell how much stronger she's gotten since the spring Tenno Sho… Those muscles are intense.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (And it's not just her physical strength that's improved. She's way more focused, too…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen isn't the only runner in the Mejiro family! And at the Takarazuka Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will show you that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (And it's not just her physical strength that's improved. She's way more focused, too…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen isn't the only runner in the Mejiro family! And at the Takarazuka Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will show you once again that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines! I'm looking forward to…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Haha, good point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Gotta start with a handshake… I'm not going to lose, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Me neither!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two competitors share a firm handshake as the curtains rise on the Takarazuka Kinen!
